release_review.historical_provenance_note: Pre-stage-2 download dates, original source revisions/oldids and transformation history were not recorded and are not reconstructed. This is a provenance limitation, not an unregistered shipped file.
release_review.legal_note: Registry review documents attribution and license handling; it is not a formal legal opinion.
